versions.changelog: Section headings for connect, tools, limits

Initial release of the apitoolcalls skill.

- Describes how to connect and use the MCP endpoint to access 90+ remote API Tool Calls.
- Supports diverse tools including QR code/barcode generators, YouTube caption readers, markdown page converters, résumé gap checkers, recall lookups, fixed SEO checks, and more.
- Lists available tools with usage examples and key requirements for select features.
- Provides both HTTP and command line interfaces, with optional OpenRouter key for advanced access.
- Centralizes tool schema discovery and remote invocation in one integration.
